title: Zainab tera Allah Nigehbaan rahega
body:
sheh kehte the jab dasht ye sunsaan rahega
zainab tera allah nigehbaan rahega
islaam ke parcham ko tu girne nahi dena
zainab tera is deen pe ahsaan rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
sar tanse juda karne ki khatir sar e maidaan
seene pe mere shimre bad-imaan rahega
har waqt khabardaar sakina se raho tum
bachchi pe mere zulm ka toofan rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aisi ghadi aayegi zainab tere sar se
chheenega jo chadar wo musalmaan rahega
darbar e sitamgaar me jab jaaoge tum sab
beemar o hazee'n shashdaro hairaan rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
eeza-e-rasan durre tamanche kabhi sehli
taskeen e sakina ka ye samaan rahega
parvaaz ghame shah e shaheeda'n me hamesha
masroof e buka chaak garebaan rahega
